topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I found this capsule today, a small, weathered box of secrets under the old oak. Its surface, pitted and marked by time, held my hands captive for a while before I could even think of prying it open. Inside, the air seemed to thicken, the light dimming just a bit, though the sun outside had not moved. Items, trinkets from another era, perhaps another me, lay dormant. Notes written in my hand, yet stranger than any ghost. A map, leading to where, I’m not sure. The world feels a bit off now, as if the earth has tilted slightly on its axis, and I’m not sure it will right itself anytime soon.
